name: Shiny monster
notes: Opens after the classic victory screen (and the items screen), only when that win made a monster shiny: the run's Alpha left a shiny seed and it was picked up (new_shiny is 0 or more). The new shiny monster's portrait bobs in the middle of a night sky, shimmering through the rainbow, with stars spraying out from behind it, under A SHINY MONSTER! and over its name and what being shiny gives it (+20% power on its moves, +40% starting HP). The victory screen already made it shiny and saved it; this screen only shows it, and a sparkling jingle plays. The victory song keeps playing. START goes back to the menu.
